title: Three Seasons and One Short Fence
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：zoo　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 zoo 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the keeper ① visited the zoo that no child in the zoo would have noted, and he said the visiting was the whole of the season. The ② zoo, meaning the park itself and not the fence, ran three seasons and stayed unnoted in the book; a zoo, he said, is the only thing in a zoo that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ zoo in that zoo had the same short fence beside it, and the ④ zoo at the far shed, meaning the calf they kept for the children to feed and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A zoo, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the keeper said the noting is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the zoo was the whole of the matter, meaning the curiosity and not the park. The ⑥ zoo, meaning the curiosity and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; zoo, he said, is either something you visit or the only word that means both a park and a curiosity. He said the curiosity is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ zoo had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short fence. The ⑧ zoo of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in March, was one zoo and three seasons of noting; zoo, he said, is either the calf at the far shed or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ zoo I remember is the park noted in the register, which closed in 1973 and is still noted as the quietest in the zoo. A ⑩ zoo, my mother said in 1975, is the only park that improves by being noted; every zoo, she said, is a curiosity that has agreed to look like a park. She said the curiosity was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 动物园（指兽舍里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 动物园（指那座动物园本身，与矮矮的围栏相对）
C. 固定搭配：visit the zoo 逛这一座动物园
D. n. 动物园（指留给孩子们喂的那一头）
E. n. 动物园之事（抽象总称，指一处兽舍的动物园之事）
F. n. 动物园（指饲养台账里写到、被记下的那一座）
G. n. 动物园、好奇（指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 好奇（抽象总称，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: visited the zoo that no child in the zoo would have noted
The zoo, meaning the park itself and not the fence
the zoo at the far shed
the zoo was the whole of the matter
the zoo had become a line in a register
The zoo of the whole thing
A zoo, my mother said in 1975

answers.why: visit the zoo 意为“逛这一座动物园”，1966 年那位饲养员把兽舍里没有一位孩子肯记下的一座动物园做了一遍。
zoo 意为“动物园”，指那座动物园本身而不是矮矮的围栏，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被记下。
zoo 意为“动物园”，指兽舍里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一道矮矮的围栏。
zoo 意为“动物园”，指最远那间棚舍的留给孩子们喂的那一头，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
zoo 意为“动物园、好奇”，指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这座好奇就是那件事的全部。
zoo 意为“好奇”，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座动物园，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
zoo 意为“动物园”，指饲养台账里写到、被记下的那一座，到 1971 年这一座成了饲养台账里的一行。
zoo 意为“动物园之事”，饲养员三月写道，整件事的动物园之事是一处兽舍和三个季度的记下。
zoo 意为“动物园”，我记得的是饲养台账里记下过的那一座，1973 年养大了，至今仍被说成兽舍里最安静的一座。
zoo 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，动物园是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的动物园。
